claims: R1 repair: for every finding F1-F8 of round 1, its regression test in tests/test_go2_operation_outcomes.py (test_r1_*) fails on f7ec03b4 and passes here, and the input class each names is handled, not only its example.

GO2-C2: a refusal is tied only to the one operation that changed the element (or the role) the issue names; when two operations changed it and nothing tells them apart, the row is unassessed, never a guess; dropped-with names exactly the operations that need an element a refused or dropped operation adds, wherever it stands in the proposal.
_needs is total over arbitrary JSON after values (mappings, tuples, lists, scalars) and reads every key the ORM meta-schema uses to name an element; it never raises.

GO2-C1/C7: with or without the option, every refusal and exit is byte-identical, an include-analysis refusal included; with --outcome-report the report is written for an include-analysis refusal and its path cannot be an include input.
The locator is linear in operations and issues, for numeric and [id=...] paths.

Every regular expression, string split, slice and special-case branch this change adds handles the whole class of input it is given, not only the examples in the tests and fixtures, and none reads structured text that a parser or an existing reader in this repository already reads.
